title: Final Answers
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final expressions for alpha, beta, and gamma.

title: Energy Density Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly derive the energy density of black body radiation and identify the dependence on temperature.

title: Debye Model Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student must explain the derivation of specific heat in the Debye model and relate it to temperature dependence.

title: Equipartition Theorem Application
description: Important Criteria: The student should apply the equipartition theorem correctly to derive the ratio of specific heats for a monatomic ideal gas.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all derived quantities have consistent units throughout the derivation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as incorrect integration limits or misapplying the equipartition theorem.

title: Mathematical Rigor
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate mathematical rigor in their derivations, including proper handling of integrals and limits.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student could discuss limiting cases or special scenarios that validate their results.
